programme.title: Kaatu Puli
programme.desc: When Sanjay's family get lost in the jungle where they have come for a picnic, they encounter a gang involved in stealing organs. So, Sanjay has to step up and save everyone.

programme.title: Ponmana Selvan
programme.desc: Raja, the eldest of three brothers, finds out that he is adopted and is shocked to learn the truth. To make matters worse, his brothers start avoiding him but he helps them when they land in trouble.

programme.title: Kaakki Sattai (1985)
programme.desc: Murali, a young man training to become a police officer, falls in love with his neighbour Uma. After failing to make the grade, he gets disheartened and turns to a life of crime.

programme.title: Thiruvilayadal Arambam
programme.desc: Guru hatches several plans to separate Priya and her lover Thirukumaran. However, Thirukumaran successfully manages to escape from Guru's evil plans and traps him in another problem.

programme.title: Chokka Thangam
programme.desc: After Muthu gets his sister married, he is caught in a fix when the groom's parents force him to marry their daughter. However, Muthu is in love with another woman, Pavazham.

programme.title: Manam Virumbudhe Unnai
programme.desc: Shanmugam falls in love with Priya but disowns his feelings when he learns that Prakash wants to marry her. Trouble ensues when Prakash assumes that Priya is cheating on him.

programme.title: Nanda Nanditha
programme.desc: Nanda, after suffering at the hands of his family, grows up to become a hitman. Things take a turn when the woman he loves sees him commit a crime and is scarred for life.

programme.title: Nathi Ondru Karai Moondru
programme.desc: Three young men fall in love with a beautiful woman and they try their very best to outwit each other and win her affection.

programme.title: Kaalai Thaeneer
programme.desc: Stay tuned to this sequence of interesting movie clips.

programme.title: Nam Naadu
programme.desc: Muthazhagu, an honest youth leader, opposes his corrupt politician father, Aalavandhar, who aspires to become the chief minister by bullying the villagers.

programme.title: Pondatti Rajyam
programme.desc: A man falls in love with a girl and marries her. After his friend passes away in an accident, the man begins to support his friend's young wife. This sows a seed of suspicion in his wife's mind.

programme.title: Jaihind
programme.desc: After his brother is killed in a terrorist attack, Bharath, a policeman, assures his mother that he will resign. However, when he learns of a secret terrorist organisation he sets out to capture them.

programme.title: Manithan
programme.desc: Raja is sent to the juvenile prison after he hits his teacher who calls him a thief. After his release, he decides to serve the needy but makes enemies who envy his social work.

programme.title: Pottu
programme.desc: Arjun fails to perform well in academics and tries to commit suicide by cutting his wrist. However, when his blood spills on the tomb of Pottu, she possesses him to exact revenge from her wrongdoers.

programme.title: Aalavanthan
